es: Reescribir un aviso de avería para un amigo y para el casero, conservando los datos y cambiando la voz (110–150 palabras).

teaching.en: Hi Mia, the boiler is leaking again, so I've called a plumber. Cheers!
teaching.es: Hola, Mia: la caldera vuelve a gotear, así que he llamado a un fontanero. ¡Gracias!
teaching.explanationEs: Con un amiga: frases cortas, contracciones y un cierre informal.
segments: Hi Mia, the boiler is leaking again,
so I've called a plumber. Cheers!
teaching.audioText: Hi Mia, the boiler is leaking again, so I've called a plumber. Cheers!

teaching.en: Dear Mr Brown, I am writing to report a leak in the boiler.
teaching.es: Estimado Sr. Brown: le escribo para informarle de una fuga en la caldera.
teaching.explanationEs: I am writing to report + problema presenta el asunto de forma formal.
segments: Dear Mr Brown, I am writing to
report a leak in the boiler.
teaching.audioText: Dear Mr Brown, I am writing to report a leak in the boiler.

teaching.en: Can you sort it out today? It's pretty urgent, mate.
teaching.es: ¿Puedes arreglarlo hoy? Es bastante urgente, colega.
teaching.explanationEs: Sort it out y pretty son coloquiales; la petición es directa.
teaching.audioText: Can you sort it out today? It's pretty urgent, mate.

teaching.en: Would it be possible to arrange a repair as soon as possible?
teaching.es: ¿Sería posible concertar una reparación lo antes posible?
teaching.explanationEs: Would it be possible to + verbo es la petición formal; arrange sustituye a sort out.
segments: Would it be possible to arrange
a repair as soon as possible?
teaching.audioText: Would it be possible to arrange a repair as soon as possible?

teaching.en: Please let me know a convenient time for the plumber to visit.
teaching.es: Por favor, indíqueme una hora que le venga bien para que venga el fontanero.
teaching.explanationEs: Convenient time deja que decida el destinatario: más cortés que dar una orden.
segments: Please let me know a convenient
time for the plumber to visit.
teaching.audioText: Please let me know a convenient time for the plumber to visit.

teaching.en: I apologise for the inconvenience and would be grateful for a quick reply.
teaching.es: Me disculpo por las molestias y le agradecería una respuesta rápida.
teaching.explanationEs: La disculpa por las molestias es típica del mensaje formal.
segments: I apologise for the inconvenience and would
be grateful for a quick reply.
teaching.audioText: I apologise for the inconvenience and would be grateful for a quick reply.

prompt.es: Tu compañera Mia necesita saber que la caldera gotea. ¿Qué mensaje eliges?

feedback.es: A una amiga se le escribe corto y directo: Hi, una pregunta con Can you…? y sin fórmulas de carta.

hint.es: Para una amiga: saludo corto y pregunta directa.

prompt.es: Completa la petición formal: «¿Sería posible concertar una reparación?»

feedback.es: Would it be possible to… convierte la orden en una petición formal; las otras opciones mantienen el tono de amigo.

origin.text: To a friend: 'Can you sort it out today?' Now rewrite it for your landlord.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le pide la hablante a Leo.

choices.text: To call the landlord about the leak.

feedback.es: La hablante dice «can you call our landlord?» por la fuga: le pide que avise al casero.

origin.audio: Hi Leo, the boiler is leaking again. It's pretty urgent, so can you call our landlord?

feedback.es: Sorry for any inconvenience es una disculpa formal, típica de un mensaje al casero.

prompt.es: Escribe las dos versiones del aviso (110–150 palabras en total).

answer.text:
Message to Mia: Hi Mia, the boiler has been leaking since Monday and the water in the bathroom is cold. Can you call the plumber today? It's pretty urgent, mate. I can be home tomorrow afternoon. Cheers, Leo.

Message to Mr Brown: Dear Mr Brown, I am writing to report that the boiler in the flat has been leaking since Monday, and the water in the bathroom is cold. Would it be possible to arrange a repair as soon as possible? The plumber could visit tomorrow afternoon, if that is convenient for you. I am sorry for any inconvenience, and I would be grateful for a quick reply. Kind regards, Leo Martin

feedback.es: Los dos mensajes llevan los mismos datos (fuga, desde el lunes, agua fría, visita mañana), pero con voz informal para Mia y formal para el Sr. Brown.
